title: Manila Water cleans over 94,000 septic tanks amid El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As Manila Water prepares its additional water sources and strengthens network resilience measures ahead of the anticipated stronger El Niño in early 2027, the company is also ramping up its sanitation and wastewater management efforts, desludging more than 94,000 septic tanks across its East Zone concession area from January to August 2026 to help protect waterways, preserve water quality, and safeguard public health. From January to August 2026, Manila Water emptied and cleaned 94,917 septic tanks. In August alone, the company serviced 11,470 septic tanks from non-sewered, sewered-combined, and sewered-hybrid domestic accounts. The initiative forms part of Manila Water’s […]...
